<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>premeditated, conscious sin</italic>, opp. שְׁגָגָה.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> ששגגות … כז' to whom errors are accounted &c.—Yoma 36
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00080">
<head-word>זָהָב</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>gold, gold coin</italic>, v. 
<xref rid="D00649">דִּינָר</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 92
<sup>b</sup> יוצק ז' רותח וכ' molten gold be poured into &c. Ex. R. s. 33 מכל עשרך … ושל ז' than all thy (Korah’s) wealth of silver and gold; a. fr.—B. Mets. IV, 1 הז' קונה את הכסף וכ' the delivery of gold coin effects the purchase of silver &c., i.e. in an exchange of coined gold for silver &c., the superior metal is the merchandise and the inferior the money; Y. ed. הכסף קונה את הז'; v. Bab. ib. 44
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְהָבִים, זְהָבִין</plural-form>. Ex. R. s. 35; Cant. R. to III, 10 שבעה (מיני) ז' וכ' seven kinds of gold were used in the Temple. Yoma 44
<sup>b</sup> שבעה ז' וכ' there are seven &c.—Erub. 53
<sup>b</sup> (in allegorical speech) והרקיעו לז' וכ' Ms. M. (ed. ארקיעו) make the gold (glowing coals) sky-blue (fan them so as to give blue flames) and prepare for me two tellers in the dark (cocks).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>silk</italic>
<language-key>(b. h. </language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083">שָׁנִי)</xref></language-reference>.</definition>
<notes> Kel. XXVII, 12 ז' טובה fine crimsom 
<italic>silk</italic>. Y. Succ. III, 53
<sup>d</sup> (defining אדמדם) ז' עמוקה deep crimsom. Pesik. R. s. 26 ומלבשתן ז' (some ed. זהורים) and clads them in silk. Nidd. 25
<sup>b</sup> כב' … של זְהוֹרִין like two threads of silk (woof); כב' … זהורית (prob. to be read זְהוֹרוֹת) like two threads of silk (warp); Y. ib. III, 50
<sup>d</sup> של זהורות; Lev. R. s. 14. Yoma VI, 8 לשון של ז' a crimson-colored strap. Tosef. Sabb. IV (V), 5 ז' שבין עיניו crimson ornament between his (the horse’s) eyes; Sabb. 53
<sup>a</sup> זַהֲרוּרִית (Ar. זהור'); a. e.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְהוֹרִיּוֹת</plural-form>. Tosef. Sot. XV, 9 ז' מוזהבות (Sot. 49
<sup>b</sup> זהורית מוזהבות, corr. acc.) gold-embroidered silks used for brides’ canopies.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup> הז' במזוזה he who is strict in the observance &c.; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. זְהִירִין,</plural-form> f. זְהִירוֹת. Ab. II, 3 הוו ז' ברשות beware of the officials. Sabb. II, 6 על שאינן ז' וכ' because they are not careful in the observance of the laws concerning &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="G00102">

<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> cmp. זהה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to be glistening;</italic> cmp. צחן a. צחח)] 
<italic>to be filthy, smell offensively, be offensive</italic>.</definition>
<notes>—Part. זוֹהֵם, or part. pass. זָהוּם. Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>c</sup> bot. ר"ל אמר ככוס ז' (not בכוס) R. L. says, It is like drinking out of an offensive cup; השותה בכוס ז' וכ' he who drinks (sacred wine &c.) out of &c. Y. Nidd. IV, end, 51
<sup>b</sup> דם נידה זהום (Tosef. ib. IX, 10 זוהם; Bab. ib. 65
<sup>b</sup>) the blood of a menstruant is sticky (or ill-smelling).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>זִיהֵם</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to smear plants with rancid oil</italic> for keeping off vermin, [oth.</definition>

<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>

<sup>b</sup> המְזַ' בכל'. Y. Gitt. III, 44
<sup>d</sup> bot. הגע עצמך שזִיוֵּוג but supposed that one matched it, i.e. found a letter of divorce just containing the names of the persons under consideration (though not written for that special transaction). Ib. כיון שאינו מצוי לזַוֵּוג אפי' ז' כמי שלא ז' since it is so rare to find such a matching combination, even if one did, we consider it as if he had not done it, i.e. such rare chances are not taken into consideration. Y. Shek. V, 49
<sup>a</sup> bot. הגע … שז' אותו היום supposed somebody produced a ticket with the mark of the same day of the week?—Ib. אפי' לזויג וכ' (read as above: כיון שאינו וכ'). Y. M. Kat. I, end, 80
<sup>d</sup> bot. מְזַוֵּוג את האומריות one who knots the fringes two by two (instead of making a regular network).—Y. Shek. V, 48
<sup>d</sup> bot. מְזַיֵּיג את הפתילות (Bab. ed. מְזַוֵּוג) he adjusted the length of the wicks (to the length of the time they had to burn); Y. Yoma II, 39
<sup>d</sup> bot.—Esp. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to join in wedlock, to wed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sot. 2
<sup>a</sup> אין מְזַוְּוגִין לו לאדם וכ' a wife is selected (in heaven) for each man according to his deserts. Ib. קשין לזַיְּוגָן וכ' to wed couples is as difficult as the splitting of the Red Sea. Gen. R. s. 68; Lev. R. s. 8, beg. מְזַוֵּוג זִיוּוּגִים וכ' He joins couples, decrees who should be married to whom. Ib. אני יכולה לזַיְּוגָם וכ' I can couple them in one hour. Ib. זווגן בלילה וכ' (read: זִוְּוגָתָן); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>

<sense>

<sense>
